description: This file contains functions for resolving 'session' directory paths within a specified agents directory. It provides both asynchronous and synchronous implementations for reading directory contents, filtering for directories, and generating session directory paths based on the directory entries.

methods.name: function mapAgentSessionDirs(agentsDir: string, entries: Dirent[]): string[] { mapAgentSessionDirs
